commits.reason: For Qwen3.8-27B with thinking on, q36 now maps the thinking budget to low/medium/high/xhigh and inserts an effort instruction for low and xhigh, and may force </think> by token rank near the budget. DStudio's batched-logits materialization is kept before the rank check (conflict resolution); earlier 8362010 real receipts do not qualify this behavior.
